about.title: About
about.paragraph1: I am a full-stack engineer focused on building fast web systems. My total focus is on performance, clean architecture, and product experience.
about.paragraph2: Merging robust interfaces in React and Next.js with stable backend structures using Node.js and AWS, I approach code analytically. My background handling critical incidents under pressure gave me the discipline to focus on root causes. In practice, this translates to hunting rendering bottlenecks, optimizing complex real-time data flows, and designing secure multi-tenant architectures.
about.paragraph3: From delivering complex BI dashboards to building interactive 3D experiences, I feel at home working with autonomy, fast deploys, and a high level of technical craft using the technologies that make up my core stack:
